inputs.prompt:
For the target video, at 0.00 seconds into the target video, <Picture 1> (from [Shot 1]) is fully referenced.

integrated_multimodal_description: [Shot 1] A single continuous ten-second cinematic LIVE-ACTION supernatural martial-arts finale. Begin EXACTLY at Picture1: the same two adult stunt actors in the same wet practical cloth costumes, yellow-and-black Scorpion LEFT and blue-and-black Sub-Zero RIGHT, boots planted in the same ruined sunlit stone courtyard. Preserve the actors' build, body proportions, costume seams and materials, courtyard doorway, columns, wet stone and ice patches. Both start with the raised guards shown in Picture1. Continue their breathing and small weight shifts immediately; no opening pose hold or reset.

Sub-Zero tries to keep that blue guard raised after the previous beating, but his elbows sink and knees soften as he struggles to steady his head and focus on Scorpion. His boots take one short uneven catching step backward; his arms try unsuccessfully to recover a defensive position. Scorpion watches that failing recovery, settles his weight onto both boots and commits to the finisher. Sub-Zero remains responsive and vulnerable instead of politely waiting in a ready pose.

Scorpion raises his RIGHT hand, visibly grips his own yellow face mask and attached black head cloth and pulls them UP AND OFF his head in one decisive connected gesture. The cloth moves with the hand and clears the head. This physical removal REVEALS a supernatural pale BARE SKULL with hollow dark eye sockets and a working bony jaw, in place of his human face. It is the classic Scorpion skull reveal: same human-sized head, same neck position and EXACTLY the same muscular yellow-and-black human body. No human face remains under the removed cloth. No flesh peeling, exposed organs, blood or close-up injury. Scorpion lowers the removed mask/hood to his right hip and KEEPS IT VISIBLY IN HIS RIGHT HAND for the rest of the shot. The cloth does not disappear or reattach. Sub-Zero keeps HIS OWN blue mask and black hood throughout.

The exposed skull turns squarely toward Sub-Zero. Scorpion braces his rear boot, leans his upper body forward, draws a short breath and opens the bony jaw. ONE forceful continuous ORANGE FIRE BREATH visibly STARTS INSIDE SCORPION'S OPEN SKULL MOUTH, travels horizontally across the real gap and STRIKES SUB-ZERO'S BLUE TORSO. Keep the skull jaw, the connected jet and the blue target readable together. Flames originate at the mouth, never from a fist, floor, chest or offscreen. Yellow clothing and removed mask remain intact; Scorpion does not burn himself.

Only AFTER the fire reaches him, Sub-Zero's torso jerks backward, his arms flare defensively, frost on his forearms bursts into white steam, and orange fire wraps around his still-recognizable blue-and-black clothed silhouette. He attempts one fast retreating step, his knees buckle, and his body collapses onto the courtyard stones in a single grounded fall with visible weight. No floating, voluntary sitting or jump into the flames. Show the complete clothed silhouette through the fire, no exposed wounds or burned-face close-up. Scorpion closes his jaw and the mouth jet stops. Remaining flames and smoke on the fallen blue costume diminish as Scorpion straightens, skull still exposed and removed mask still held at his right hip. End with the fallen Sub-Zero and standing skull-faced Scorpion both in frame, smoke and cloth still moving. No resurrection or mask reset.

CAMERA begins at Picture1's exact perspective. Make a controlled short same-axis lateral dolly during the mask removal, keeping yellow LEFT and blue RIGHT and revealing the skull in three-quarter profile. Ease backward during the fire and collapse to keep both complete bodies, the connected mouth-to-target flame path and the blue landing visible. Show subtle courtyard-column parallax; no axis crossing, spin, cuts, slow motion or artificial shake. Photographic live-action sunlight, practical cloth and human bodily weight. Only the supernatural skull and fire change the established appearance. No extra people, weapons or chain. Serious decisive performance, no comedy, no victory dance, no speech or music.

overall_soundscape: Continuing courtyard wind, uneven blue boot scuffs, yellow cloth and mask pull, a short intake of breath, one forceful fire roar from the skull mouth, brittle ice crackle turning to a steam hiss, stumbling boots and a heavy body landing on stone, then fading flame and smoke. No speech, grunts, laughter or music.

non_diegetic_music: None.

_meta.title: T07 — mask removal, skull reveal, mouth-origin fire and collapse
